name: Suluan Damaged Lighthouse
blurb: A fixed Hangar-only damaged lighthouse: tapered masonry tower with entrance porch, gallery and railing, glazed lantern and dome, its upper section sheared away on one side with shell holes and rubble, no emitted light.
history: Suluan sits at the eastern approach to Leyte Gulf and appears in Philippine navigational references; U.S. Rangers landed there on 17 October 1944. No drawing or photograph of the actual tower was found, so this campaign-state lighthouse is an estimated tapered masonry form with an estimated damage pattern, not a reconstruction.

sources.title: United States Coast Pilot, Philippine Islands
